motor_connector.splice: TE 320559, one 0.75 mm² motor conductor to one 16 AWG pigtail per splice; four splices
motor_connector.connection_status: Four stripped pigtails clamp directly into J2; no mating housing or terminal crimp. Splice crimps, exposed-copper length, retention and continuity require first-article acceptance.
motor_connector.current_note: 10 A UL rating; 17.5 A IEC nominal. 16 AWG pigtails are within the specified stranded range; qualify temperature rise at the intended motor current.
motor_connector.termination: WAGO lever-operated spring clamp, one stripped stranded conductor per pole

mating_access.basis: Conservative space above the lever-operated WAGO terminal for wire insertion and lever actuation. Nominal body height 16.58 mm; mechanical tool/finger access and wire bends require physical checks.

required_connectors.J1: USB-C EPR motor power; requested separate POWER input
required_connectors.J10: USB DATA/setup/diagnostics; separate from EPR input
required_connectors.J2: Four motor winding leads; WAGO 2601-3104 lever-operated spring clamp
required_connectors.J3: External braking resistor required by the retained regenerative brake stage

optional_encoder.sensor: AS5600-ASOM; I2C angle readout, optional and DNP
optional_encoder.blocked_by: Ordered single-shaft motor has no documented rear magnet interface; sensor fitting requires a qualified magnet/holder/air gap.

limitations: No physical assembly, crimp or motor test was performed.
External harness parts are separate procurement items; PCB supplier stock checks do not reserve or certify them.
No motor mounting hardware is modeled; rear screw specification, board clearance and physical cable restraint remain unresolved.
